subject: Vendor remittance / VAT evidence — AP onboarding clarifications
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@ocelothealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts.payable@ocelothealth.com
Date: 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor remittance and VAT evidence for Redwood Inference

Hi Lauren,

We're kicking off vendor setup for Redwood Inference in our AP system and I had a couple of quick questions before we complete registration. Attached is our AP onboarding packet with the fields we need (Ocelot_AP_Packet_v2.xlsx). Can you confirm the following?

- Preferred remittance method: ACH / wire / vendor portal (we prefer ACH). If ACH, please confirm the remit email or remittance advice format.
- EFT cutoff for same-day processing — our Treasury requires funds submitted by 16:00 UTC to hit the next business day. Will that work on your side?
- Tax/VAT evidence: we need supplier VAT registration (EU VAT ID or US tax form as applicable) and a registered billing address that matches the VAT record. Do you have a VAT ID or W-9/W-8?
- PO acceptance: Does Redwood require a specific PO number field on the invoice or will an email confirmation suffice for your procurement to match?

If you prefer, we can provisionally register you and link your portal account pending the VAT docs. Let me know the fastest path — we typically aim to enable vendors for payment within 7 business days once paperwork is complete.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Senior Procurement Manager
Ocelot Health
attachments: Ocelot_AP_Packet_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@ocelothealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 11 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor remittance and VAT evidence for Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia — thanks for the packet, and for outlining your timelines. Quick answers below and next steps attached (Redwood_AP_Onboarding_20261014.pdf). I copied our AP lead (Marissa) and accounting ops (Jonas) for any technical follow-ups.

- Remittance method: We prefer ACH. Remittance advices can be sent to ap-notices@redwood.ai or attached to the invoice email; our payments team parses PDF remittance or structured XML. If your portal generates an automatic advice, we can consume that.
- EFT cutoff: 16:00 UTC is fine in most cases, but please note bank settlement times can add delay for international wires. If funds need to clear on a specific date, include that in the payment instruction.
- Tax/VAT evidence: Redwood (US entity) will provide a W-9 for US payees; for EU VAT interactions we can supply our VAT registration (attached: Redwood_Tax_ID_2026.pdf). For Ocelot's needs — please confirm which country/region's VAT ID you need us to present.
- PO acceptance: We require a PO number present on the invoice in the PO: line (either in the invoice body or in the invoice PDF filename). An email that references the PO is acceptable only as interim confirmation; final matching is automated by PO field.

Next steps
1) We've attached our AP onboarding PDF with our preferred remit fields and sample invoice. Please return your completed packet or upload to the portal.
2) If you need EDI/CSV files for remittance parsing, Jonas can share a spec.
3) Once we have the VAT docs and completed packet, Marissa will confirm the vendor record and provide the vendor ID for future POs.

If helpful I can jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow to go through the packet.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_20261014.pdf; Redwood_Tax_ID_2026.pdf

From: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@ocelothealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts.payable@ocelothealth.com
Date: 12 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor remittance and VAT evidence for Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — that's very helpful. A few clarifications from Treasury & AP:

- VAT/evidence: We need the supplier VAT ID that will appear on invoices for EU-based billing. If Redwood invoices from the US entity, please confirm whether VAT is applicable or if we should process as reverse-charge (we'll need the EU VAT to evaluate).
- PO acceptance: Our system requires the PO number either in the invoice PDF (searchable text) or in the invoice filename. Can you confirm the invoice generator will include the PO: field in a searchable form?
- EFT cutoff: Confirmed 16:00 UTC. Our bank file generation runs at 16:15 UTC so payments submitted by your cutoff will be in the outgoing batch.

I've attached our treasury EFT spec for your integration team (Ocelot_Treasury_EFT_spec.pdf). If you can confirm the PO field behavior and provide the VAT ID or W-9, we can complete setup.

Best regards,
Sofia
attachments: Ocelot_Treasury_EFT_spec.pdf

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@ocelothealth.com>, accounts.payable@ocelothealth.com
Date: 14 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor remittance and VAT evidence for Redwood Inference — proposed onboarding responses

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Ocelot's packet and treasury spec. Below is the proposed set of deliverables to close onboarding. Please review and confirm we can:

1) Supply Redwood_Tax_ID_2026.pdf to Ocelot as VAT evidence and note: Redwood invoices from the US entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.). For EU customers we sometimes invoice via our EU subsidiary — if required, I'll coordinate.
2) Ensure our invoicing template includes a searchable "PO:" field on the first page of the PDF and in the PDF metadata/filename (we'll set format: INV-{PO}-{INVNUM}.pdf).
3) Provide AP contact (ap-notices@redwood.ai) and enable parsing of their remittance XML if Jonas agrees.
4) Accept their EFT cutoff (16:00 UTC) for on-time processing and confirm bank details in our vendor record.

Sofia — copying you here so Marissa and Jonas can confirm technical details. Proposed timeline: we will return the completed packet and vendor ID within 3 business days after tax docs are received.

Thanks,
Lauren
